# Heading one

Body text should use the brand base family and size, on the brand background color with the brand foreground color. Links such as <https://quarto.org> should use the brand primary color and be underlined.

## Heading two

Headings should use the brand headings family, weight, and color.

Inline code like `x <- 1` uses the brand monospace family. A block:

```r
mean(rnorm(10))
```
